dct_title_s: Geologic map of the White Ledge Peak quadrangle, Santa Barbara and Ventura Counties, California
dct_description_sm: by Thomas W. Dibblee, Jr. ; edited by Helmut E. Ehrenspeck.
Geology overprinted on U.S. Geological Survey 7.5-minute topographic quadrangle.
Prepared in cooperation with U.S. Forest Service, Los Padres National Forest, California Department of Conservation, Division of Mines and Geology, and U.S. Geological Survey.
Alternate title: Geology - White Ledge Peak quadrangle.
Includes legend, microfaunal age chart, and index to sources of geology.
